arguments.proof:
intro hdim
obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := h_H001
let e : GPI → GPEucl (n + 1) := fun t => GPappend x₀ (t : ℝ)
have he_mem : ∀ t, e t ∈ GPproduct E := by
  intro t
  change GPhead (GPappend x₀ (t : ℝ)) ∈ E ∧
    (GPappend x₀ (t : ℝ)) (Fin.last n) ∈ GPI
  rw [(h_T001.1 n x₀ (t : ℝ)).1, (h_T001.1 n x₀ (t : ℝ)).2]
  exact ⟨hx₀, t.property⟩
have he_dist : ∀ t u, dist (e t) (e u) = |(t : ℝ) - (u : ℝ)| := by
  intro t u
  change dist (GPappend x₀ (t : ℝ)) (GPappend x₀ (u : ℝ)) = _
  rw [h_T001.2.2.1 n x₀ x₀ (t : ℝ) (u : ℝ), dist_self]
  simp only [zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), zero_add,
    Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_abs]
have hbound : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ dimH (GPproduct E) :=
  (h_T017.2.2 (n + 1) (GPproduct E) e he_mem he_dist).1
simpa only [hdim, zero_add] using hbound

result.stdout:
T019 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GPEucl n)),
  E.Nonempty →
    ((∀ (k : ℕ) (x : GPEucl k) (t : ℝ), GPhead (GPappend x t) = x ∧ (GPappend x t).ofLp (Fin.last k) = t) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : GPEucl (k + 1)), GPappend (GPhead z) (z.ofLp (Fin.last k)) = z) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ) (x y : GPEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (GPappend x t) (GPappend y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
            ∀ (k : ℕ) (z w : GPEucl (k + 1)),
              dist (GPhead z) (GPhead w) ≤ dist z w ∧ |z.ofLp (Fin.last k) - w.ofLp (Fin.last k)| ≤ dist z w) →
      (dimH GPI = 1 ∧
          (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → GPmass s GPI = ⊤) ∧
            ∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (GPEucl k)) (e : ↑GPI → GPEucl k),
              (∀ (t : ↑GPI), e t ∈ A) →
                (∀ (t u : ↑GPI), dist (e t) (e u) = |↑t - ↑u|) →
                  1 ≤ dimH A ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GPcontent s δ GPI ≤ GPcontent s δ A) →
        dimH E = 0 → dimH E + 1 ≤ dimH (GPproduct E)
'Translation.T019' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
